mapper.select: /* selectBuyerMpRqQuotationNegoHistoryPopList */ SELECT A.BUYER , A.QUOTATION_NO , A.QUOTATION_SEQ , A.REVISION , A.NEGO_SEQ , A.NEGO_PRICE , TO_CHAR(A.NEGO_DATE,'YYYYMMDD') AS NEGO_DATE , A.BTOA_NEGO_PRICE , A.BTOA_NEGO_REMARK , A.CREATE_USER_ID FROM BNTNEGOHISTORY A WHERE A.BUYER=#{st_buyer} AND A.QUOTATION_NO=#{st_quotation_no} AND A.QUOTATION_SEQ=#{st_quotation_seq} AND A.REVISION=#{st_revision} ORDER BY A.NEGO_SEQ DESC
